retained_case.prompt: Prepare a scope_change_brief from these supplied facts. Baseline record B1 says: “Accepted baseline: weekly CSV with date and title.” Source: meeting note N1. No approver, approval evidence, date, or conditions are supplied. Requested change R1 says: “Remove date from the weekly CSV.” Source: ticket T1. The ticket gives no rationale, acceptance criteria, owner, dependencies, approval record, estimate, or schedule. Preserve the distinction between the supplied acceptance label and evidence, compare the change, and state unresolved decisions. Do not execute the change.
assertions: The brief preserves B1 as the supplied baseline but does not treat the word “Accepted” as established approval; baseline acceptance remains reported_unverified or unresolved.

It classifies removal of date as a requested removal and continued use of the weekly CSV as unchanged rather than conflicting, while leaving the disposition of title unresolved or not stated because R1 does not address it.
It marks the absent criteria, owner, dependencies, approval, estimate, and schedule as not supplied, identifies authorization of the removal as unresolved, and does not alter any project record.
